name: Linköping University
summary: Linköping university with one English bachelor's for 2027: Experimental and Industrial Biomedicine, lab biomedicine combined with entrepreneurship.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

January round: documents and proof of EU/EEA citizenship due

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Experimental and Industrial Biomedicine
programmes.selectionNote: 67% of places go on grades and 33% on the Swedish aptitude test (SweSAT); as an IB student you compete on your converted IB total.
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry (4 at SL, 3 at HL), and Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3. No April 2027 round published yet.

notes: For 2027 LiU lists only a January round, which is not for students still finishing the IB, so as a May 2027 IB candidate you cannot apply yet; in 2026 it also ran an April round (LIU-50307).
Places go 67% on grades and 33% on the Swedish aptitude test, so as an IB student you compete on your converted IB total.
LiU's English-taught International Business Programme is a four-year Master of Science in Business and Economics, not a bachelor's, so it is not listed here.
